### Caveats
- absolutes are calibrated ranges (util/PUE/WUE assumed); lead with relative/spatial results.
- Q3 routing is a stylised controller (synthetic demand, conditional on R-hat) — Ceiling reach, not headline.
- India carbon national-annual; sub-national signal rides on water. Coordinates are city-centroids.
